positions.title: Front End Software Developer
positions.description:
Write high-quality reusable code to develop the dynamic user interface for various platforms.
Collaborate with project managers, senior developers, and business partners for work planning, sharing new ideas, code demonstrations, troubleshooting, and bug fixing.
Optimize front-end elements to maximize performance across different devices and browsers.
Assist team members in architectural compliance, functional accuracy validation, and adherence to appropriate industry standards.

positions.title: Application Development Project Manager
positions.description:
Managed Phase 2 Development work for large scale farming client.  
Updated current application with new features to include backend and frontend features.  
Worked closely with client to gather requirements.
Managed daily scrums, design planning meetings, retrospectives, and client demonstrations.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), React.js and +4 skills

positions.title: Web Development Consultant
positions.description:
•	Support the customer as a User Experience and Front End Designer for a research and development  group.
•	Utilize the Adobe Creative Cloud Suite(Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Dreamweaver, Flash, Fireworks, After Effects, Premiere, Media Encoder, Captivate) to create promotional material (logos, advertisements, and presentations), interface design, web design, and computer based training.
•	Front End Design for web application, Windows desktop application, JAVA applications, and mobile applications. Focus on User Experience Design / User Centered Design.  Starting with User Interviews, paper mockups, to working prototypes. Use Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator  to for mock-up of the design.  
•	 Intermediate level knowledge of CSS and HTML. Intermediate knowledge of Bootstrap framework.  Beginner knowledge of JavaScript and AngularJS. Work with frontend and backend developers to design user interfaces.  Provide HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to frontend developers and work with backend developers to hook up the data.
•	Beginner knowledge or XAML and Designing Windows Applications.
•	Beginner knowledge of JAVA FX and designing desktop applications with JAVA.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Design Consulting and +1 skill

positions.title: Project Management Consultant
positions.description:
·	Manage client engagement and implementation work for financial client migration role out. 
·	Work with Account Mangers and Customer Service representatives to execute communication plan.
·	Manage small team consisting of technical implementation managers. Provide clear roles and guidance for team members. 
·	Work with technology team to coordinate the migration for all compliant customers.
·	Created a reporting dashboard to track client progress through migration process.
·	Educate clients on the new program requirements and engage with clients to ensure they understand the project timelines.
positions.insights: Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Microsoft Excel and +2 skills

positions.title: Lead Multimedia Specialist - Graphics Developer
positions.locationName: Mclean, VA - Customer Site Dulles, VA
positions.description:
•	Support the customer as a Graphics Developer for a research and development  group.
•	Work with the group to create and maintain a brand identity.  
•	Utilize the Adobe CS6 Master Collection (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Dreamweaver, Flash, Fireworks, After Effects, Premiere, Media Encoder, Captivate) to create promotional material (logos, advertisements, and presentations), interface design, web design, and computer based training.
•	Act as Site Collection Administrator (SCA) for the SharePoint Teamsite.  Create, manage, and maintain the site. Use SharePoint Designer to update workflows and site content.
•	Work with developers to design user interfaces for web and mobile applications.  Use Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator  to create the initial mock-up of the design and then use Adobe Dreamweaver to write the CSS and HTML.  Beginner level knowledge of CSS and HTML.
•	Utilize Autodesk Maya to create 3D animations for promotional media.  Use Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro to compile and create the final product. 
•	Use Adobe After Effects to develop motion graphics for promotional media for products and services the group provides. 
•	Edit  live video and add effects for Tech Talks using Final Cut Pro, After Effects, & Premiere Pro.  Work with a team to create the script and film the live video in front of a green screen.  Beginner knowledge of shooting video in front of green screen. 
•	Beginner knowledge or XAML and Designing Windows Applications.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.locationName: Mclean, VA - Customer Site Springfield VA
positions.description:
•	Project Manager for a team of 13 people. 
•	Understand and communicate Human Resource/Development policies and procedures.
•	Communicate corporate information to team members.
•	Ensure they comply with corporate responsibilities.
•	Manage time using Deltek System. 
•	Conduct Performance Reviews for all employees
•	Conduct weekly meetings with team.
•	Participate in weekly management meetings. 
•	Submit employees for annual awards.
•	Coordinate with Program Managers and organize information into agendas for team member notes.
•	Participate in proposals for new contract and contract renewals by editing, formatting, and writing technical volume, resumes and task orders. Create process graphics to explain task orders and technical data.

positions.title: Lead Multimedia Specialist - 3D Animator
positions.locationName: McLean, VA - Customer Site Springfield, VA
positions.description:
•	Produce Three Dimensional Animated Movies and Graphics for the government customer. 
•	Create models and animations using the latest version of Autodesk’s Maya (3-D Animation software), and the latest Adobe Creative Suite (CS5) Products (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Audition, After Effects, and Media Encoder). 
•	Proficient in the use of Maya tools for modeling, camera animation, object rigging, lighting, shading, nDynamics, and Dynamics for particle and nCloth creation. 
•	Skillful in the Adobe Premiere Pro with editing, cutting, annotating, audio, and adding effects to animations.
•	Translate and present the data received from the customer into a visual representation for demonstration and analytical purposes.
•	Work closely with imagery analyst, geospatial analyst, and intelligence analyst, to guarantee their overall message is being conveyed correctly.
•	Conceptualize analytical data into simple easy to understand visualizations to include 3D vehicle models, annotated graphics, 3D PDF’s, and animations.
•	Strong understanding of geospatial data such various forms of imagery, terrain and shapefile data.
•	Proficient in imagery and terrain manipulation software such as Global Mapper, Remote View, and ESRI Products.
•	Combine imagery, terrain, custom built features (buildings, vehicles, and equipment) into short animated movies that are utilized in analyst’s reports and briefings (NIBS, IR’s, PDB).
Brief high level policy makers on animations products and services.

positions.title: Geospatial Analyst
positions.description:
•	Created Digital Three-Dimensional and Two-Dimensional maps to integrate into intelligent mapping software (InterScope and UrbanAnalyst).
•	Used ESRI ArcGIS software to compile shapefile data of urban areas.  Gathered and formatted shapefile data for conversion to 3D information in Terex.
•	Used Autodesk Maya to create 3D building models that were integrated into 3D mapping software.
•	Organized and administered the procedure for the deployment of software, hardware and training materials for the DHS 30 Cities Contract. 
•	Wrote test procedures for software testing and performed various forms of quality assurance. Trained customers on software for DHS 30 Cities Contract. 
•	Designed marketing material for products and data released to the customer.

positions.title: 3D Modeler
positions.description:
•	Worked for a government contractor on the Multispectral Environment Engineer Team (MEET). 
•	Designed three-dimensional graphics for flight simulators using Multigen Creator and Adobe Photoshop. 
•	Created, complied, and designed documentation for customers.
